title: Add merge and linked-worktree branch-scope integration coverage
description: Build process-level integration fixtures that create tasks from a main worktree and linked worktrees on different named branches, using a shared flat-file store where useful. Assert deterministic distinct 8-hex branch tokens, per-branch 0001 sequences, collision-free merged task/index manifests, branch-local ready/next behavior, legacy fallback, foreign exclusion, and explicit foreign start. Include nested invocation discovery and a simulated independent-branch merge of tracked .wtp files. Keep paths and assertions cross-platform and do not rely on branch names being filesystem-safe.
